correctness.rationale: Two n-multisets are confusable exactly when their multiset intersection contains a size-two multiset. Choosing any doubled symbol of each repeated-symbol word gives distinct symbols across such words, because a common doubled symbol would be a common two-survivor output. Replacing these words by their constants is injective, preserves the distinct-symbol words, and introduces no conflicts. Missing constants can be added; the distinct-symbol part is exactly an n-uniform pair packing. Counting and the reverse construction establish both the identity and the existential normalization. For n>q there are no packing blocks, and for n=q there is one. For n=2 the expression is q+binom(q,2), the total number of length-two multisets, as expected when no deletions occur. The maximum partial triple-system formula gives the four residue classes by elementary simplification, including q=2 via the empty packing convention.
